# Psalm 51 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 51:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Be-gracious to-me, O-God, according-to Your-steadfast-love; according-to the-abundance of-Your-compassions blot-out my-transgressions.
- **LOGOS:** Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your steadfast love; according to Your abundant mercy blot out my transgressions.
- **PNEUMA:** Have mercy on me, O God, because of Your unfailing love. Because of Your great compassion, blot out the stain of my sins.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
